questions.question: In the days of King David and his son Absalom, how did both men regard Ahithophel's advice?

answers.text: Like consulting the word of God
Like the ruling of a judge
Like the orders of a commander

questions.question: Why did Absalom reject Ahithophel's plan to chase King David and follow Hushai's advice instead?

answers.text: The LORD planned to defeat his advice

questions.question: During Absalom's rebellion, Hushai told the priests to quickly send King David a message. What was it?

answers.text: Cross over and do not stay the night
Hide in a cave and wait it out
Come back and fight Absalom now
